hi-county-officials.summary: The County card says how the county is governed, and names none of its mayor or council members.
hi-county-officials.why: No statewide list of Hawaii's county officials has been read for this app yet, and the counties' own pages have not been read one by one.
hi-county-officials.wanted: A list of each county's mayor and council members, from the state or from the county itself.
